entities.description: A medium-sized, light brown corrugated cardboard box is being held by a person's right hand, which is gripping the side near a black cutout handle. The box is sealed with clear packing tape along the top seam and has a flap folded over the top edge.

A close-up view of a light brown cardboard box with a rectangular handle cutout on the side, sealed with clear packing tape on the top and bottom edges. The box is stacked on top of another similar box, with a portion of the box above it also visible.

A plain, light brown cardboard box with a rectangular cutout handle on the front face and a piece of clear packing tape sealing the top flap. The box is positioned in the foreground, appearing to be stacked on top of another box, with a person wearing a yellow sweater partially visible in the background.
